title: Memory
coreMove: Build a retrieval path while the material is still warm instead of hoping recall appears later.
sourcePressure: Memory becomes a method chapter, framing recall as supported by encoding, association, and retrieval rather than as a fixed gift.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning memory into spectacle, photographic claims, or party tricks.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen sidecar contains no chapter-local named figure, named study, named place, or dated anecdote. Use fictional protagonists and keep source alignment at the concept and title-pressure level.

hook: Do not open Memory with a generic unlocked potential claim.
Do not start with a definition of memory.
counterintuition: Do not use a not X but Y correction shell.
Do not claim the opposite of common sense in generic coaching language.
tryThisNow: Do not use set a timer and reflect.
Do not ask the reader to journal broadly without a visible action.
examples: No repeated desk, kitchen, classroom, commute, or generic meeting shells.
No six examples built around timestamp plus named protagonist plus decision.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: planner must remember client constraints across twenty vendors
exampleSpecs.stakes: one forgotten allergy can ruin the reception
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Lucy turns each constraint into a vivid association tied to the vendor card before the call stack grows.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: ivory place cards spread beside a phone

exampleSpecs.audience: harbor supervisor recalling emergency steps under noise
exampleSpecs.stakes: a drill begins with no printed checklist allowed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Matteo links each emergency step to a physical point on the dock and walks the route once before the drill.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: wet cleats squeaking on a dock plank

exampleSpecs.audience: staffer learning donor names and preferences
exampleSpecs.stakes: renewals depend on personal recognition at gala check-in
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hanna connects each donor name to one concrete preference on the seating chart, then retrieves it before greeting.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a seating chart dotted with colored tabs

exampleSpecs.audience: student must recall sequences accurately under stress
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Jack builds a recall route from case type to sequence, then tests himself with the card face down.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a laminated protocol card turned face down

exampleSpecs.audience: guide learning dates and stories for a historic walk
exampleSpecs.stakes: tourists will ask without waiting for notes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Nina predicts the next date at each doorway cue before checking the guide sheet.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: brass door numbers on a rainy street

exampleSpecs.audience: engineer needs command recall when systems are down
exampleSpecs.stakes: search may be unavailable during an outage
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Layla compares a notes-open drill with a notes-closed drill and strengthens the missing retrieval path.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a terminal prompt waiting after a simulated outage

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm, using a question to the reader, a research aside only if source-supported, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: Identify when build a retrieval path while the material is still warm instead of hoping recall appears later. is needed in a new scenario.
Choose the visible action that matches Memory rather than a nearby generic lesson.
Explain why the weak alternative fails without using recall-only phrasing.

tryThisNowSpec: Attach one fact to a vivid cue and retrieve it once before the material cools.
